page.overview:
Who is King Vegeta's Warriors?

A group of Saiyan warriors personally led by the king of Planet Vegeta, King Vegeta. The group originally appeared as a branch of Saiyan Army elites within the Frieza Force.

In the anime, at some point, King Vegeta led a group of the most powerful mid-class Saiyan. During one of their assignments, Prince Vegeta executed several inhabitants of a planet while Nappa and three other mid-class Saiyan laughed sadistically. When the inhabitants of the planet defended themselves, the mid-class Saiyan shielded themselves (either with technology or their own energy shield). Then, King Vegeta effortlessly destroyed the survivors with an Explosive Wave while Nappa, his son, and the three Elites watched, of which the resulting Explosive Wave was powerful enough to destroy both the planet they were currently on as well as the orbiting moons.

The first of this group has black hair and black Battle Armor. The second greatly resembles Shugesh in hairstyle, build, and their teal Battle Armor color, though the elite has blonde hair and darker skin. The third has reddish-like hair and black-and-green Battle Armor. Interestingly, each wears a green scouter, and their Battle Armor designs are nearly identical from each other's and Bardock's.

In Dragon Ball Super: Broly, King Vegeta is shown flanked by ten Saiyan warriors (presumably the mid-class referred to in a prior interview) wearing white capes when meeting with Cold and Frieza. These Saiyans are later present in King Vegeta's throne room when Paragus seeks an audience with him.
